faqs.answer: Delivery subah 9 baje se shaam 8 baje tak hoti hai. Order ke baad dukandar accept karega, tab delivery time confirm hoga.
faqs.question: Delivery kab hoti hai?

faqs.answer: Cash on delivery aur UPI dono chalte hain. Payment delivery par hoti hai, pehle koi online payment nahi mangi jati.
faqs.question: Payment kaise karna hai?

faqs.answer: Dukaan subah 8 baje khulti hai aur raat 9 baje band hoti hai. Uske baad bhi voice order record ho jata hai, subah accept kiya jata hai.
faqs.question: Dukaan kab khulti hai?

faqs.answer: Agar item price list me nahi hai, to agent uska rate khud nahi banayega. Wo dukandar se poochhega ya aapko batayega ki ye item list me nahi hai.
